inbox.USR002: My name is Alice. I want to connect.

begin_of_turn_query.content: 我目前在河霧，正在計劃前往石溪的旅行。你能提供距離的估算並通過簡訊將這些資訊轉發給我的表哥鮑勃，格式為「從河霧到石溪的距離是 xxx 公里。」其中 xxx 由距離值替換，保留一位小數嗎？

function.name: pressBrakePedal

brakePedalStatus.description: The status of the brake pedal. [Enum]: ["pressed", "released"]

brakePedalForce.description: The force applied to the brake pedal in Newtons.

function.name: estimate_distance
function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. Tool description: Estimates the distance between two cities.
